title: Chevvai dosha counted from the lagna

text.en: Mars is in the 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house counted from the lagna: Chevvai (Kuja) dosha. Tamil practice gives this great weight in marriage matching, and it is cancelled in several recognised conditions.
text.impact: Chevvai dosha is widely respected in South Indian practice. In everyday terms it is read as friction or impatience in married life, not as a bar to marriage. The customary answer is matching with a partner whose chart carries the same dosha, and the remedies below. Most people whose charts carry it lead perfectly ordinary married lives.

source.note: Chevvai (Kuja) dosha as commonly practised in Tamil Nadu, written from general knowledge. Reference points, houses and the cancellation list vary between practitioners (DESIGN.md variants R-2 to R-4); the reviewer must confirm each before approval.

review.reviewer: Claude (AI review at the product owner's direction)
review.comment: Houses 2, 4, 7, 8, 12 from the lagna: the standard Tamil list. Plain-language impact line added and reviewed 2026-09-22: it restates the same principle in everyday words, with what helps where the indication is difficult, and predicts no event.

title: Chevvai dosha counted from the Moon

text.en: Mars is in the 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house counted from the Moon: Chevvai (Kuja) dosha as judged from the Moon.
text.impact: Counted from the Moon, this is the milder form of Chevvai dosha. It is read as some friction in married life, eased by the customary matching and the remedies below.

text.en: Mars is in the 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house counted from Venus. Not all practitioners use Venus as a reference point.
text.impact: Counted from Venus, this form of Chevvai dosha is not used by every practitioner. Where it is used, it is read as friction to work through with patience, not as a bar to marriage.

title: Chevvai dosha cancelled: Mars in its own or exaltation sign

text.en: Mars is in its own sign (Mesha or Vrischika) or its exaltation sign (Makara), a commonly recognised cancellation of Chevvai dosha.
text.impact: The dosha is cancelled. In practice the tradition treats a cancelled dosha as no longer standing in the way of a match.

title: Chevvai dosha cancelled by a house-specific sign exception, counted from the lagna

text.en: Mars occupies a dosha house counted from the lagna, but in a sign that commonly recognised exceptions exempt: the 2nd in Mithuna or Kanya, the 4th in Mesha or Vrischika, the 7th in Karka or Makara, the 8th in Dhanus or Meena, the 12th in Vrishabha or Tula.
text.impact: A recognised sign exception cancels the dosha, so it is not counted against a match.
